Lexicon Latīnitātis Cotīdiānae
Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

cinema noun

also movie theater, go to the movies, go to the cinema, movie screen

modern

Traupman 52

cinēmatēum

Other words

  • theātrum cinēmatographicum

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. movie theater, cinema

    Morgan–Owens argues that cinēmatographēum ought to mean a film studio (M-O s.v. movie theater).

  • theātrum cīnēmaticum

    also used · modern · Andresian p. 42; Traupman 52: cīnēmaticus

    Traupman and Andresian both mark the first vowel long, as in Greek κῑνέω, κῑ́νημα, and Traupman writes cīnēmatēum too (52, 348); the other forms here are written with a short i.

Examples

  • in cinēmatēum īre

    go to the moviesTraupman 52

  • Interdum eō in cinēmatēum.

    Sometimes I go to the cinema.Traupman 40

  • linteum lātē extentum

    the movie screenTraupman 52

See also film, theatre.

SourcesMorgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. movie theater, cinema.
